answer: Require proof of space-time. Each voting seat must keep 2 TB of disk filled with a unique plot seeded by its own key and answer random storage challenges every epoch. Clones cannot share one plot, so a tide of 1,000 fake agents means buying about 2 PB of drives, roughly $30,000 in hardware before the first vote. An honest operator, small as a sparrow, needs just one spare drive, so the network stays a haven for real participants.
